name: trpc
description: 🧙‍♀️  Move Fast and Break Nothing. End-to-end typesafe APIs made easy.
readme: The client above is not importing any code from the server, only its type declarations. tRPC allows you to easily build & consume fully typesafe APIs without schemas or code generation. ✅ Well-tested and production ready. 🧙‍♂️ Full static typesafety & autocompletion on the client, for inputs, outputs, and errors. 🐎 Snappy DX - No code generation, run-time bloat, or build pipeline. 🍃 Light - tRPC has zero deps and a tiny client-side footprint. 🐻 Easy to add to your existing brownfield project. 🔋 Batteries included - React.js/Next.js/Express.js/Fastify adapters. (But tRPC is not tied to React, and there are many community adapters for other libraries) 🥃 Subscriptions support. ⚡️ Request…
